name: Shirasaka Taichi
source:
Class: 2-B

Taichi, Mio's protective younger brother and guiding figure to Mei, is a conscientious young man deeply attached to his family. Following their recent relocation, a chance encounter leads him to develop a subtle fondness for Megumi.

However, amid these new beginnings, his concern for Mio grows when he notices her unusual behavior in the new environment and her recent recovery. Unraveling this mystery, he stumbles upon a bizarre organization. As the depths of Mio's association with this group become apparent, and with Megumi seemingly entangled too, Taichi becomes resolute in guiding them both away from its potentially dangerous influence.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=804105]Getchu[/url]]
